pages.title: Configuring Effects
pages.text: All nutrition effects are defined in $(thing)config/nourished/effects.json$(). Created automatically on first launch with sensible defaults.$(br2)You can:$(br2)$(li)Change which nutrients trigger which effects$(li)Adjust thresholds and durations$(li)Add entirely new effects$(li)Disable any existing ones$(br2)$(italic)No code required.$()

pages.title: Effect Triggers
pages.text: Effects support the following trigger types:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)below$() — nutrient drops below a threshold$(li)$(thing)above$() — nutrient exceeds a threshold$(li)$(thing)all_above$() — $(bold)ALL$() nutrients exceed a threshold$(li)$(thing)any_below$() — $(bold)ANY$() nutrient drops below a threshold$(li)$(thing)between$() — nutrient is within a range
